payload.title: [calls-token-1] SFU join-token (HMAC nonce) is minted but NEVER verified on produce/consume/connectTransport
payload.description:
AUDIT FINDING calls-token-1 (high/authz, confidence=high, verify-votes +2/-0)

FILE: apps/server/src/calls/sfu-media-plane.ts
LINES: 172-214, 231-260, 279-284

WHAT: issueJoinToken() mints a coturn-REST-style HMAC nonce `${expirySeconds}.${HMAC(secret, callId:userId:deviceId:expirySeconds)}` (#mintNonce, lines 279-284) and returns it in the grant. But SfuMediaPlaneAdapter has NO verify method at all, and connectTransport/produce/consume (lines 231-260) only call #requireSession(callId) — they never receive or check a token. The control plane (call-control-plane.ts sfuConnectTransport/sfuProduce/sfuConsume, lines 454-486) and the gateway dispatch (gateway.ts 1746-1793) likewise never pass or validate the token; authorization is done purely from the gateway principal's participant record. The entire HMAC token path is dead code: signature, expiry, and the callId:userId:deviceId scope binding are never enforced. The documented contract ('The server re-derives and checks it (and the expiry) on produce/consume', lines 277-278) is false.

IMPACT: The token provides zero security. Its intended guarantees — expiry (a joined participant can keep producing/consuming forever, well past the 5-minute TTL) and per-(callId,userId,deviceId) scoping — are not enforced anywhere. Combined with calls-media-1, there is no media-layer credential gating ops.

SUGGESTED FIX: Add a verifyJoinToken(callId, actor, token) on SfuMediaPlaneAdapter that re-derives the HMAC with crypto.timingSafeEqual, rejects on signature mismatch or expiry (now() >= expirySeconds*1000), and binds callId:userId:deviceId. Thread the token from the client through CallCommand → control plane → media plane and call it in #requireSfuParticipant before forwarding to the backend.
